owner: Existing coordinator implements and executes required targeted/regression checks; operator checkpoints.

policy.deadline_boundary: Open iff assessment instant < deadline instant. Equality and later are closed.
policy.unknown_precision: Missing, invalid, date-only or offsetless deadline remains unknown for precise action. No assumed timezone or end-of-day.
policy.freshness: Same UTC day initially; normalize aware instants and reject future observation. Any age-window replacement is a separately declared policy.
policy.clock_roles: Explicit query/capture, buying assessment, evidence cutoff, source observation and presentation; historical replay distinct from current presentation.
policy.source_authority: Source/passage-bound; attachments remain discovery_only unless independently upgraded under an authorized trust contract.
policy.frozen_cases: No changed capture, scoring or source artifacts.
policy.existing_contracts: Preserve current display-time rebind, independent original results, strict Assess requirement trust and legacy report date contract until explicitly migrated.
